lessons.correction: Focus on developing economy and tech while maintaining production. Strengthen ground army as a baseline.
lessons.mistake: Committing to a large army before knowing the opponent's plan, or over-expanding without defense.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have more information about enemy composition or when you reach a tech milestone.
lessons.title: Avoid premature army commitment
lessons.when: Early game, around 180 seconds, with unknown enemy posture and heavy tech investment.
lessons.why: Early game is about establishing a strong economy and tech base. A ground-oriented army provides flexibility against unknown enemy tech.

lessons.correction: Continue strengthening ground army and increase production. Maintain expansion and tech progression.
lessons.mistake: Neglecting defense while expanding, or committing to a single tech path without information.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when enemy tech becomes apparent or when you have a significant army advantage.
lessons.title: Balance expansion with defense
lessons.when: Early-midgame, around 240 seconds, with ground-oriented posture and heavy production.
lessons.why: Heavy production allows a strong ground army. Continuing to expand and tech gives a long-term advantage.

lessons.correction: Maintain defensive posture while continuing to develop ground army. Increase economy and tech.
lessons.mistake: Continuing to expand and tech without reinforcing the army, assuming the enemy is passive.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when enemy tech direction becomes clearer or when you have a sufficient army to push.
lessons.title: Maintain defense while developing
lessons.when: Early-midgame, around 360 seconds, with ground-oriented posture and enemy ground cues.
lessons.why: Siege Tanks provide strong defensive capabilities against ground pushes. Maintaining defense while expanding gives a safe economy.
